## Top B2B Content Marketing Statistics 2024

1. 82% of marketers are actively using content marketing, 10% report not using content marketing, and 8% are unsure if their company uses content marketing ( [HubSpot](https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/State-of-Marketing%20(2).pdf), 2021)
2. 40% of B2B marketers have a documented content marketing strategy, and 64% of the most successful B2B marketers have a documented content marketing strategy ( [Content Marketing Institute](https://contentmarketinginstitute.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/b2b-2023-research-final.pdf), 2022).
3. 81% of the least effective businesses don’t have a recorded content marketing strategy, compared to 64% of top performers. ( [Content Marketing Institute](https://contentmarketinginstitute.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/b2b-2023-research-final.pdf), 2022)
4. 81% of marketers view content as a core business strategy ( [Content Marketing Institute](https://contentmarketinginstitute.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/2021-content-management-strategy-final.pdf), 2021).

![Top Content Marketing Statistics](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/top-content-marketing-statistics.png)Source: [SEOwind](https://seowind.io/)

## Content Marketing Strategy Statistics 2024

5. 90% of our respondents say that content marketing is part of their marketing strategy, and 66% say this strategy is documented—that’s compared to 57% who documented their strategy in 2022. ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/state-of-content-marketing/), 2023)

![90% of our respondents say that content marketing is part of their marketing strategy, and 66% say this strategy is documented—that’s compared to 57% who documented their strategy in 2022. ](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/documented-content-marketing-strategy-1024x576.png)Source: [SEOwind](https://seowind.io/)

6. 80% of those who considered themselves very successful in content marketing in 2022 have documented their content marketing strategies, as do 73% of content marketers who regard their efforts as successful. ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/state-of-content-marketing/), 2023)

![80% of those who considered themselves very successful in content marketing in 2022 have documented their content marketing strategies, as do 73% of content marketers who regard their efforts as successful](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Have_a_documented_content_marketing_strategy_-1024x576.png)Source: [SEOwind](https://seowind.io/)

7. 36% reported they are taking their first steps in content marketing, 42% of respondents claimed their strategy was fairly developed, whereas 22% reported an advanced content marketing strategy ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/state-of-content-marketing/), 2023)

![36% reported they are taking their first steps in content marketing, 42% of respondents claimed their strategy was fairly developed, whereas 22% reported an advanced content marketing strategy](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/content-strategy-maturity-1024x576.png)Source: [SEOwind](https://seowind.io/)

## Content Marketing Tactics Statistics 2024

8. In 2022, 47% of content marketers reported that researching their audience was the most important factor for content marketing success. 46% of those surveyed considered SEO as having the greatest impact, whereas 45% publishing more content. Updating and repurposing existing content was mentioned by 38% of respondents as a success factor. ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/state-of-content-marketing/), 2023)

![Factors leading to success in content marketing semrush 2023 Linkedin](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Factors-leading-to-success-in-content-marketing-semrush-2023-1024x666.png)Source: [SEOwind](https://seowind.io/)

9. 83% of marketers say it’s better to focus on quality rather than quantity of content, even if it means posting less often ( [Hubspot](https://www.hubspot.com/state-of-marketing), 2022)
10. 55% of marketers say creating more content and posting more often helped most with ranking their content organically. The second tactic that contributed to higher rankings was improving the quality of their content (53%), which was followed by creating more research-driven content (37%). Marketers reported also following tactics to contribute to boosting ranking: paying more attention to keyword research (36%), analyzing search intent for their content (35%), and improving technical SEO on their website (30%). ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/state-of-content-marketing/), 2023)

![tactics that helped the most to boost ranking 2023](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/tactics-that-helped-the-most-to-boost-ranking-blog-2023-1024x666.png)Source: [SEOwind](https://seowind.io/)

## Content Marketing Goals Statistics 2024

11. Content marketing is a proven strategy for creating brand awareness, building trust, and educating audiences. 83% of marketers report that using content marketing in the last 12 months helped them create brand awareness (a 3% increase since last year), 77% build credibility and 72% educate the audience (2% increase each). Moreover, 67% of marketers report that content marketing generates demand/leads (a 7% increase since last year) and 63% say that it helps build loyalty with existing clients/customers (a 3% increase) ( [Content Marketing Institute](https://contentmarketinginstitute.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/b2b-2023-research-final.pdf), 2022)

![Content Marketing Institute content marketing goals statistics](https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/bHTEg7yf3MHy6VqNtahOkoHCxhohaNMHWsot0-Zf1-AGMek_ZTg5Atu4flX5g9OAmDb3Eh95FJCVOoWF_PiGs6RlSVIBEKXCnoh4uuY6hS8WZbuJYyqe4jjC1sYdDxEzz48ERFL75PSWZpOBEAzsCM5atwcrOAigDSgSCkm3V3YrP13oVnZRfh0KbU0vWA)Source: [Content Marketing Institute](https://contentmarketinginstitute.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/b2b-2023-research-final.pdf)

## Content Marketing Challenges 2024

12. 45% of respondents consider attracting quality leads with content as the main challenge in content marketing. Creating more content faster (and finding resources for it) is perceived as a challenge by 38% of research participants, and generating content ideas and generating enough traffic with the content by 35%. ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/state-of-content-marketing/), 2023)

![top content marketing challenges](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/top-content-marketing-challenges-semrush-2023-1024x666.png)Source: [SEOwind](https://seowind.io/)

13. Creating content that appeals to different stages of the buyer’s journey is named the top current content marketing challenge by 61% of respondents. 50% of research participants list aligning content efforts across sales and marketing and 43% developing consistency with measurement ( [Content Marketing Institute](https://contentmarketinginstitute.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/b2b-2023-research-final.pdf), 2022)

## Content Marketing Budgets Statistics 2024

14. 46% of businesses reported they want to increase their content creation spending by more than 9% in 2022. ( [Content Marketing Institute](https://contentmarketinginstitute.com/articles/b2b-power-content-marketing-research/), 2022)

![Content Marketing Institute content marketing budget statistics](https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/B1cHORmEpWDjQ6qL7HSg7zP3AD_5XypHbWNOfUTRV4uBBMJalHzWgdSJ-mZDC0mGlpwtte43UqJ54xfYut4XSUGH3pkBzjRPCsQ1ZHyhDhTjtBurLgOZVDliBeGIM69mUcYvJgKB925fJdOOTkMFVXrOFMHXBOLwR0_MisgpoPCJTDSlgitr36J6fjUjTw)Source: [Content Marketing Institute](https://contentmarketinginstitute.com/articles/b2b-power-content-marketing-research/)

15. During a late 2021 survey carried out among professionals involved in content marketing, 42 percent of respondents stated that they expected their content budgets to increase over the next year; 20 percent expected them to stay the same, and three percent to decrease. ( [Statista](https://www.statista.com/statistics/1292027/content-marketing-budget-change/), 2023)
16. During a global survey carried out in 2020, 37 percent of responding marketers said their company spent up to 10 thousand U.S. dollars that year on content marketing efforts. According to two percent of surveyed industry professionals, their content marketing budgets for 2020 ranged between 500 thousand and five million U.S. dollars. ( [Statista](https://www.statista.com/statistics/265349/content-marketing-spending-worldwide/), 2023)
17. The top five areas of investment for 2022 are video (69%), events (digital, in-person, hybrid) (61%), owned-media assets (57%), paid media (55%), and social media management /community-building (39%).  ( [Content Marketing Institute](https://contentmarketinginstitute.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/B2B_2022_Research.pdf), 2021)

## Content Marketing Outsourcing Statistics 2024

21. Companies outsource to freelance writers with reputable brands coming from referrals (47%). Digital marketing and content marketing agencies are in second place, with a result of 27%. Content writing service providers came in third with a share of 24%. Freelancers that provide their writing services on popular gig sites are the choice of 17% of respondents, and AI writing tools are in last place, but with a noteworthy result of 12% of votes. ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/marketplace/state-of-content-ops-and-outsourcing-report), 2021)

![semrush content marketing outsourcing statistics](https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/5TU443RhW6-8WdrMDxSDCdoUxeFDAsbLSG95raWY50AvT_bInrFvfhSpZhhAbmUuyJa9lOJEOJLIPl7ubvgQ9ZWX17o60L8kgrtFsok0snot6wiETNDlJfiS-YjqJfWpwL9jC9MjeT042u7hqJ4t8AgECUuLE6PyKzPE6HdiXoozZye_EMq7YzV6qFhMag)Source: [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/marketplace/state-of-content-ops-and-outsourcing-report)

22. When choosing a content provider, providing in-depth, high-quality content is the most important trait (44% of respondents). Reasonable prices also often prove to be a deciding factor (40% of respondents). The third place takes experience in the industry. ( [SEMrush](https://www.semrush.com/marketplace/state-of-content-ops-and-outsourcing-report), 2021).

![Semrush content provider factors statistics](https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/5ttIbvImiqtH3vvVRhERrRk8z22U6DUkY9hkPp0KoajHH0SyIc-W8uEPSRv0zoCoP3d2twpq21tYwRd3XtVQpbdFakYGf8hZRMxAchq-q4XdJ8OEhjX7kuMMPIIRYLEI7cXcyBmAjnfmdX2GkGR-2PD_0vO7URTO3CfPpyPqV_eVgzTa_cVQIBvQCwvsUw)Source: [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/marketplace/state-of-content-ops-and-outsourcing-report)

23. How much do companies spend on outsourcing content writing monthly ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/marketplace/state-of-content-ops-and-outsourcing-report), 2021)

When we look at how much different businesses spend on outsourcing, we find that the numbers run inversely to cost. Over half of the survey respondents spend $5,000 or less per month on external content writing, with 37.17% spending less than $1,000. Meanwhile, only 5.01% of companies allocated more than $30,000 monthly to such support.

![semrush outsourcing content writing budget statistics](https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/FMw6TgnqvIJ76U3TedvGA8LAwy9fPej_hlcoG-aAIprnhIEvLcMtz5xKnxhpj4lH54ebH5K5QgLhmmVF4oFJvzfmElIOWkfqUMRppb4aUG2c0IzwPiZzZyFMKQsGy7Oi9Wg9tag0bouEgGlVqkeJyJZ_Yscxr2FCTAnB23rh0FUt9DQ0dyR09ysOx2d1Gw)Source: [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/marketplace/state-of-content-ops-and-outsourcing-report)

24. Challenges with outsourcing content writing ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/marketplace/state-of-content-ops-and-outsourcing-report), 2021)

As for the main hurdles with content writing outsourcing, it seems that experience and quality present the biggest issues. 48.53% of respondents report having difficulty finding writers with experience while 41.47% report insufficient writing quality. Meanwhile, the company’s own level of required effort has also proved a deterrent, with 35.59% unhappy with the amount of editing needed and 27.94% pointing to excessive explanation expectations.

![semrush most challenges when outsourcing content writing statistics](https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/OCt99vT0ZWkB6ZxnoinQFAayqMkbkpiNVtBBdCOclaTF1j8VQqdlNwWTLswvnByM9pxb7CWQkEtsk87Vy52QLASfnFnYq0e-a2JnmwTI4nE1Ws0CKJmfAhH6li5P2mvS9nCJTsxbRqjIvn4LxBqpoVNm15YLstQVFsJTHKSqjvDFw_8-6tlpwM8ZfJMFmw)Source: [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/marketplace/state-of-content-ops-and-outsourcing-report)

25. 75% of large companies [outsource content marketing](https://seowind.io/outsource-content-writing-services/) ( [Content Marketing Institute](https://contentmarketinginstitute.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/B2B_2022_Research.pdf), 2021).
26. About 50% of all B2B marketers said they outsource content marketing activities, and 65% said their biggest challenge is finding partners with adequate subject matter expertise. ( [Content Marketing Institute](https://contentmarketinginstitute.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/B2B_2022_Research.pdf), 2021)

## Content Formats and Content Types Statistics 2024

27. The video was the primary form of content being created in 2022, followed by blogs (used by more than half of marketing teams), and images ( [HubSpot](https://www.hubspot.com/state-of-marketing), 2022).
28. Content formats/types that brought your company the best results ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/marketplace/state-of-content-ops-and-outsourcing-report), 2022)

There is a noted disparity in the expected value delivered by different forms of content. Videos and blog posts proved the most useful for 37% and 36% of companies, respectively. While success stories offered the best results for 22% of respondents, no other format type was reported as most valuable by more than 16% of organizations.

![semrush content formats best resutls statistics](https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/9sOE2MYDuezZr0pb5qF_VwnZI4sS-aUylgKrfH_lD3RD0alMVHAhoJAGerHr--WIMsPdX1cOSgnwsxYM5hSjb6I334y6PoNbvEzvYrP3QB9tibvG1IKHpNN6iFp_soZ6yA9MYEAtaALC27Rc_FP7Qk8kRm_BJbXPiWT9g35CA9Ld55vNYXBLF140FeTOZg)Source: [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/state-of-content-marketing/)

29. Content Assets B2B Marketers Created ( [Content Marketing Institute](https://contentmarketinginstitute.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/b2b-2023-research-final.pdf), 2022)

The value indicated above is further represented in the rates at which marketers are creating and using content. Short articles and posts were the most common over the past year, with 89% of respondents reporting creation and use. Videos are also in high demand (75% of respondents), while case studies round out the top three (67%).

![Content Marketing Institute content assets created statistics](https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/95ymAPNmhWygrZa5T_0JTF8dyE2hQJW_87Hu557065iPNH6hXHbK5Mo-H5yhdkIUJJTxLBidgwmOEmaMcx3HmVio23EJOb2okhmXA5oSU8HIVlC7g3FAPP6B-VBIgL5fEhxhJtkQWtKm4juqdK2iSONfRA0NHp5ChAaBeZMldDqg5tFFSw2m_kFeXbNP1g)Source: [Content Marketing Institute](https://contentmarketinginstitute.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/b2b-2023-research-final.pdf)

30. B2B Content Assets That Produced the Best Results in the Last 12 Months ( [Content Marketing](https://contentmarketinginstitute.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/b2b-2023-research-final.pdf) [Institute](https://contentmarketinginstitute.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/b2b-2023-research-final.pdf), 2022)

The impact of B2B content assets provides less clarity, with seven options delivering top results for 36-48% of respondents. Events scored high, with in-person gatherings reported as most valuable by 48% of businesses and digital options right behind at 47%. Research reports (43%) and e-books (43%) also broke the 40% threshold.

![Content Marketing Institute content assets with best results statistics](https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/glTyDdy9_aBuVv9Cxw1dFvxDar4MU1w-L4_mMz4GGx8uKlU14dJ5zTyoRnTnfWMbqHUCNiLWCDU2GRuDwGimaLtf4RIXyUmexC39fDyJLoUtMn8MV5IKaVixdiSotcmq6kQiq5SFwq4CN-uUQJAy682KftmMhBkniYc-QiHk89Q2MO13-45vszc4DDP-6Q)Source: [Content Marketing Institute](https://contentmarketinginstitute.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/b2b-2023-research-final.pdf)

31. What content formats/types have you produced so far ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/marketplace/state-of-content-ops-and-outsourcing-report), 2021)

As for the content that companies have actually produced, most of the work has gone into written content. Blog articles (67.94%), web copies (58.53%), email copies (48.53%), and product descriptions (43.82%) are the most common among respondents. More design-related content such as video scripts and presentations, fall among the least common content that has been created.

![semrush content formats statistics](https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/K5PTlY2abxOLvf9Str5gl7a_IzXOp5enxOiwsEUYIK-K5vtSpgtMMCY4OGh9pG13C7Cj2z76JP1hrv9OUH6OqjAmTVZ5bD4kRJl1n-R81wGfO9r4HZ4HrzW9wNZBsFMqrczqr26dK_20od2xtbx8-OaPsYC8avZTcKqaREsbS2M9UTFuMdLQoZrCjkEo5w)Source: [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/marketplace/state-of-content-ops-and-outsourcing-report)

32. Top media formats marketers use ( [HubSpot](https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/2022_State-of-Inbound-Marketing-Trends), 2022)

In keeping with other surveys considering usefulness, videos and blogs once again take the top spots in this HubSpot report. However, images, infographics, and case studies are all close in the overall frequency of use. Each of these five has clearly found a place among the regular tools that marketers are comfortable using.

![HubSpot top media formats statistics](https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/goyAdt0g0WGDI-Un1Eb5HVIpMO9k6Pzqe5bmBLx1UTxYf69NeNKosQWhHdFpkzJ3J6t1FYx0VEdLOs4CubebWwaCQK14gRmllCws19PwH7_d6T1Q2ThOmuOJdcfYP7vBBu5XmzMWBLycDcyY96JEimRZWAMNHsDO8cKpYsjqpVC08NlQLNlCoJeVKo-4sA)Source: [HubSpot](https://www.hubspot.com/hubfs/2022_State-of-Inbound-Marketing-Trends)

## Content Briefs Statistics 2024

33. What do marketers usually include in their [content briefs](https://seowind.io/content-brief/) ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/marketplace/state-of-content-ops-and-outsourcing-report), 2021)

When SEMrush looked into the most common elements of content briefs, marketers most commonly indicated the inclusion of a topic (67.45%) and keywords (64.71%). As these are the most basic elements of copywriter and SEO activity respectively. The target audience (50.29%) and content objectives (49.71%) also show a high rate of use in copywriting briefs. SEO writing instruction are included by almost 37% of respondents.

## Content Quality Statistics 2024

34. Qualities of well-written content ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/marketplace/state-of-content-ops-and-outsourcing-report), 2021)

The key ingredients to well-written content seem to be a native level of language ability and comprehensive topic coverage, which were selected by 67.65% and 61.18% of respondents respectively. ## Content Marketing Performance Metrics Statistics 2024

35. 66% of companies measure content performance in some way, which leaves 20% of those who don’t and 15% who are not sure ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/marketplace/state-of-content-ops-and-outsourcing-report), 2022)

The top three content marketing metrics are organic traffic, search rankings, and leads. 51% of content marketers use organic traffic as a key metric for measuring content success, 42% search rankings, and 40% leads. Only 8% use backlinks. ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/blog/content-marketing-statistics/), 2022)

![semrush key metrics for content success statistics](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/fVX1M06N91GfmeltodcLoigDBzHc_vZJXnWhEyHMjAy-Wqf2XcUm7Uf-bgu8_AJ2tHm7KfSAzK9jilVTMxW1DbJaD0NUM9tDxWuFtHm0k2ytCgApOzbAMkD24D_Vh82nFAfOqiLAtC9s_YtQ1hrWpsisY4501HFbLkWfKAwe3yPpLOdUVAiSILx6srWdWA)Source: [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/state-of-content-marketing/)

37. What are your top metrics to measure content success ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/marketplace/state-of-content-ops-and-outsourcing-report), 2022)

For effectively measuring the success of content, organic traffic (68.82%) and social traffic (46.76%) seem like the dominant options among respondents. Other important metrics such as time on page (38.24%), generated leads (37.35%), and conversions remain relevant, but to a lesser degree. Once businesses get beyond the most common options, there seems to be a great diversity of preferred metrics.

![semrush top performance metrics for content success statistics](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/TBuWsJKEo7M5kQQAVDEQ9sbeGMFFpJ82pbxkR_K-k91Kgs306PdRqbf0Y_BUboxnys_9qrfUZt_9D9afXBplLoSOaogSTLSKIQWyXHoKcwoY5DM8oVijo5wIOhlPxSqT8XWJ3PrgYDQe8jAIN3UFYssSmTv5JRyZzMqP_fGlVqldEe9VMoJd4cn-CU-6lQ)Source: [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/marketplace/state-of-content-ops-and-outsourcing-report)

38. How do you measure the success of your content marketing strategy ( [HubSpot](https://cdn2.hubspot.net/hubfs/53/tools/state-of-marketing/PDFs/Not%20Another%20State%20of%20Marketing%20Report%20-%20Web%20Version.pdf), 2020)

While a HubSpot review from 2020 indicated that sales are the most frequently used indicator of content marketing success, they are far from alone. While no other option cracked the 20% threshold, four others were within 10% of the leader. Lead generation, web traffic, online engagement, and social engagement provide value to a wide variety of businesses.

![hubspot content matrketing strategy success metrics statistcis](https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/0hK0Iw9UWK0GDqhWPd-ZXN16eCtvf9g58t10PUghf-9drt6rSgPlmtvbF-rYIXN4TpccbdZWe06T1tPow597nl-jJ8fUh68bHn834u0SNS1yMcR1kKFT6oFY3CfiVpRoyrLzpBGAUsfpQxzNiyGBYxXd0BRpq-WmNb6z2U4K5oysaxykO5kh1XqhmcQWeQ)Source: [HubSpot](https://cdn2.hubspot.net/hubfs/53/tools/state-of-marketing/PDFs/Not%20Another%20State%20of%20Marketing%20Report%20-%20Web%20Version.pdf)

## Content Audit Stats 2024

40. 65% of companies that succeed in content marketing run [content audits](https://seowind.io/website-content-audit-tools/) more than twice a year ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/state-of-content-marketing/), 2022)
41. 46% of companies whose content marketing was unsuccessful in 2021 never run content audits ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/state-of-content-marketing/), 2022)

![key takeaways on content writing statistics ](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Key-takeawys-content-writing-statistics-1024x666.png)Source: [SEOwind](https://seowind.io/)

68. The “Everything You Need To Know” titles and Comparison articles generate the most organic traffic on average. ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/goodcontent/state-of-content-marketing/report), 2023)

![content writing statistics everything you need to know titles and comparison](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/headllines-1-everything-you-neeed-to-kno-1024x244.png)

69. Articles with “Mistakes To Avoid” titles and Guides get the most shares ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/goodcontent/state-of-content-marketing/report), 2023)

70. How To and Comparison articles attract the most backlinks ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/goodcontent/state-of-content-marketing/report), 2023)

89. 87% of marketers stated that creating video content increases their website traffic ( [Wyzowl](https://wyzowl.s3.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com/pdfs/Wyzowl-Video-Survey-2022.pdf), 2022)
90. Articles with at least one video also generate 70% more organic traffic than those without. ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/goodcontent/state-of-content-marketing/report), 2023)

![Articles with at least one video also generate 70% more organic traffic than those without](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Articles-with-at-least-one-video-also-generate-70-more-organic-traffic-than-those-without.-Semrush-2023-1024x244.png)

91. Only 8% of all blog posts we analyzed had a video. ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/goodcontent/state-of-content-marketing/report), 2023)

![Only 8% of all blog posts we analyzed had a video.](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Only-8-of-all-blog-posts-we-analyzed-had-a-video.-1024x224.png)

92. 43% of respondents pointed to Short-form video formats performing best. ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/state-of-content-marketing/), 2023)

![43% of respondents pointed to Short-form video formats performing best](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/43-of-respondents-pointed-to-Short-form-video-formats-performing-best.-Semrush-2023-1024x224.png)

93. 91% of businesses use video as a marketing tool in 2023. This is an all-time high since 2016. ( [Wyzowyl](https://www.wyzowl.com/video-marketing-statistics/), 2023)
94. 70% of ‘non-video-marketers’ plan to start online video marketing in 2023. ( [Wyzowyl](https://www.wyzowl.com/video-marketing-statistics/), 2023)
95. 95% of video marketers say that video marketing has helped them increase brand awareness, while 91% say that it has helped increase traffic. ( [Wyzowyl](https://www.wyzowl.com/video-marketing-statistics/), 2023)
96. 96% of people have watched an explainer video to learn more about a product or service. ( [Wyzowyl](https://www.wyzowl.com/video-marketing-statistics/), 2023)
97. 89% of people say watching a video has convinced them to buy a product or service. ( [Wyzowyl](https://www.wyzowl.com/video-marketing-statistics/), 2023)
98. According to a report by Wyzowl in 2023, 66% of marketers created live-action videos, while 57% created screen-recorded videos. Additionally, 55% of marketers used animated videos. ( [Wyzowyl](https://www.wyzowl.com/video-marketing-statistics/), 2023)

![66% of marketers created live-action videos, while 57% created screen-recorded videos. Additionally, 55% of marketers used animated videos. (Wyzowal, 2023)](https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/ctziv6jfHSq3ayNe1N0V9yKhS1UnLo_HSGOS4iNRUlOcO5ttOq8HWVwIaCADrVMxaSvKtQBB3bxZW8gNs2rRQAIT-Y8E0rNKLTILM2One8VmAEWLYuNManZbTqiygXp4IBU7r6OoPu-S7ZZ0yULCPNM)

97. YouTube is the most widely used video marketing platform with 90% of video marketers trusting the world’s #1 video site. Next up is Facebook (86%), followed by Instagram (79%) and LinkedIn (also 79%) as a string to their video marketing bow. ( [Wyzowyl](https://www.wyzowl.com/video-marketing-statistics/), 2023)
98. 90% of marketers using short-form video will increase or maintain their investment next year, and 1 in 5 marketers plan to leverage short-form video for the first time in 2023. (Hubspot, 2022)

## Content Marketing Market Size Statistics

99. The content marketing industry is expected to be worth $412.88 billion by 2023 The global content marketing market size is estimated to increase by USD 584.02 billion between 2022 and 2027. ( [Technavio](https://www.technavio.com/report/content-marketing-market-size-industry-analysis), 2022)
100. The market’s growth momentum will progress at a CAGR of 16.37%. ( [Technavio](https://www.technavio.com/report/content-marketing-market-size-industry-analysis), 2022)

## AI Content Marketing Statistics

101. 3 out of 4 B2B marketers use generative AI tools in content and marketing. 72% of respondents say they use generative AI tools. ( [Content Marketing Institute](https://contentmarketinginstitute.com/articles/b2b-content-marketing-trends-research/), 2023)
102. Among those who use generative AI tools, 91% use free tools (e.g., ChatGPT). 38% use tools embedded in their content creation/management systems, and 27% pay for AI tools. ( [Content Marketing Institute](https://contentmarketinginstitute.com/articles/b2b-content-marketing-trends-research/), 2023)
103. About half (51%) use generative AI to brainstorm new topics. Many use the tools to research headlines and keywords (45%) and write drafts (45%). Fewer say they use AI to outline content (23%), proofread (20%), generate graphics (11%), and create audio (5%) and video (5%). ( [Content Marketing Institute](https://contentmarketinginstitute.com/articles/b2b-content-marketing-trends-research/), 2023)
104. Asked if their organizations have guidelines for using generative AI tools, 31% say yes, 61% say no, and 8% are unsure. ( [Content Marketing Institute](https://contentmarketinginstitute.com/articles/b2b-content-marketing-trends-research/), 2023)
105. The top 3 main reasons why B2B marketers don’t use generative AI tools include accuracy concerns (36%), lack of training (27%), and lack of understanding (27%). 22% percent cite copyright concerns, and 19% have corporate mandates not to use them. ( [Content Marketing Institute](https://contentmarketinginstitute.com/articles/b2b-content-marketing-trends-research/), 2023)

## Most Important Content Marketing Statistics according to marketing experts

106. 28% of Marketers Use PR and Media Outreach ( [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/state-of-content-marketing/), 2023)

_Public relations is an integral part of content marketing, as it amplifies the content’s reach and impact. It serves to build relationships with influencers, journalists, and other stakeholders to promote content across multiple channels. Ultimately, 28% of marketers using PR and media outreach to promote their content is a crucial statistic that marketers should know as they plan and develop their 2023 content marketing strategy_, claims [Gosia Hytry](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gosiakomosa/), Head of Content, [Spacelift](https://spacelift.io/).

102. By 2024, it’s projected that there will be 8 billion digital voice assistants in use worldwide. ( [Statista](https://www.statista.com/statistics/973815/worldwide-digital-voice-assistant-in-use/), 2022)

[Nick Cotter](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nick45/), Founder, [newfound](https://www.newfoundr.com/) makes the point: _This shows the growing importance of optimizing content for voice search and using this technology in content marketing strategies. Voice search is becoming increasingly popular because of the convenience and ease of use it provides, especially for mobile users. Marketers who optimize their content for voice search can improve their visibility and reach a wider audience, as well as enhance the user experience._
